text: dsh-local-font-picker 是一款适用于 DSH Web 的界面插件，在设置的 General 区域加入字体选择面板。用户可请求读取浏览器可访问的本机字体名称，为界面文字和代码分别选择字体，也可手动输入名称；面板提供预览和恢复默认操作，字体值通过 DSH Theme API 写入核心字体设置。适合希望调整 DSH Web 字体显示的用户。读取本机字体列表需要浏览器支持 Local Font Access API、Secure Context 和用户授权；不需要 API 密钥。

dsh-local-font-picker adds a font panel to DSH Web settings. It lists local font names through the browser API or accepts manual input, applies separate UI and code fonts, shows previews, and resets to defaults. Listing fonts requires API support, a secure context, and browser permission.
想给 DSH Web 的界面换成本机安装的字体。
How can I pick a different font for code in DSH Web?
DSH 能不能列出电脑里装好的字体让我挑选？
dsh-local-font-picker 的功能「选择 UI 和代码字体」：在 General 字体面板加载本机字体或手动输入名称，分别设置两种字体，可预览并恢复默认。

dsh-local-font-picker README · dsh-local-font-picker：English | [日本語](README.ja.md)

A community plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI that lets you choose installed local fonts for the interface and code surfaces.

> This is a community-maintained plugin, not part of the DeepSeek Harness core distribution.

dsh-local-font-picker README · What it does：- Lists locally installed fonts through the Local Font Access API (`window.queryLocalFonts()`).
- Applies the selected UI and code fonts through the built-in DSH Theme API (`ctx.theme.setFontFamily(role, value)`); persistence, CSS application, and reload restore belong to the DSH core settings.
- Keeps no settings of its own — no `localStorage`, no Theme token overrides. The built-in font settings and this plugin row always read and write the same core state.
- Falls back to manual font-name entry when the Local Font Access API is unavailable.
- Requires no changes to the DSH source tree and no plugin build step.
dsh-local-font-picker README · What it does：The host entry (`index.js`) is intentionally a no-op. All behavior runs in the Web client.

dsh-local-font-picker README · Compatibility：Since **0.3.0** this plugin delegates font state to the DSH core (`ctx.theme.setFontFamily`); it stores nothing of its own. Earlier plugin releases kept their own copy in `localStorage` plus Theme token overrides. The table records runtime verification per listed state; rows up to 0.2.1-alpha.1 were recorded on the pre-0.3.0 mechanism.

dsh-local-font-picker README · Compatibility：DSH **0.2.1-alpha.2** added built-in font-family settings. Since 0.3.0 this plugin writes exactly those core settings, so no competing plugin-side state remains; earlier plugin releases (0.1.x–0.2.x) kept their own overrides in parallel and were never verified against the built-in settings. Upgrading from a pre-0.3.0 release does not migrate the old copy automatically: the plugin stops reading its `localStorage` state and no longer installs Theme token overrides, so fonts show whatever the core font settings hold (the defaults after a clean upgrade) until you select a font family once in the settings row. The browser-stored entry older releases left behind is no longer read; removing it is optional and changes nothing else. Versions later than 0.2.2-rc.1 are not assumed compatible until verified.

dsh-local-font-picker README · Install：Add a local checkout of this repository to the target DSH profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add <absolute-path-to-this-repository>
```

Restart DSH Web after installation.

dsh-local-font-picker README · Usage：Open **Settings → General → Fonts**.

- Use **Load PC fonts** to request access to the browser's local font list.
- Select or type an installed font family for the UI font and code font; the value is written to the DSH built-in font settings and stays in sync with the built-in font rows.
- Use **Reset to default** to hand both roles back to the built-in font list.

dsh-local-font-picker README · Usage：Button and status labels follow the copy language described above: the English list shows **Load PC fonts**, Japanese shows **PCフォントを読み込む**, and the same applies to the rest of the row.

Copy language follows the browser's preferred languages, not the DSH Language setting. The first usable preference decides: `ja` renders Japanese, anything else renders English.

dsh-local-font-picker README · Limitations：- Local Font Access is primarily available in Chromium-based desktop browsers. Other browsers can still use manual font-name entry.
- Font settings live in the DSH core settings and are shared with the built-in font rows; this plugin adds no separate storage.
- Requires DSH **0.2.1-alpha.2** or newer — the core font-family settings the plugin delegates to were added there.
- DSH is still evolving rapidly, so client extension contracts can change between prerelease versions.
- The copy language is decided once when the row module loads. Changing the browser's preferred languages takes effect on the next page reload.

dsh-local-font-picker README · Check：```sh
npm run check
```
